question: Which shape do most mandatory (regulatory) road signs have?
explanation: Mandatory (regulatory) signs are circular (cl. 3.1). STOP (octagon) and GIVE WAY (triangle) are specified separately.

en.question: Which shape do most mandatory (regulatory) road signs have?
en.explanation: Mandatory (regulatory) signs are circular (cl. 3.1). STOP (octagon) and GIVE WAY (triangle) are specified separately.

hi.explanation: अनिवार्य (नियामक) चिह्न गोल होते हैं। स्टॉप (अष्टभुज) और रास्ता दें (त्रिकोण) अलग से निर्धारित हैं।

question: What must you do at a STOP sign?
options: Slow down and continue if clear
Come to a complete halt, then go when safe
Stop only if other vehicles are present
explanation: At a STOP sign you must stop before the transverse STOP line, give way to traffic on the major road, and enter only when the way ahead is clear (Reg. 7).

केवल तभी रुकें जब दूसरे वाहन हों
